message.content: Magnus Carlsen retained his title by winning the 2015 World Chess Championship against Sergey Karjakin.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015 between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen defended his title. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.

But maybe they mean "World Chess Championship" or "FIDE World Cup"? But likely it's the World Chess Championship. Provide answer accordingly. Also mention that Carlsen retained his title.

Thus respond with: Magnus Carlsen won the 2015 World Chess Championship.
